en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the façade of a large brick educational building with a stone base and steep tiled roofs. The structure forms an L‑shape around a courtyard and features many rectangular windows with decorative brickwork and some window flower boxes. In the foreground is a street with a low wall and sparse young trees; a few pedestrians are visible. Printed Hungarian text at the top left describes the institution and mentions Kolozsvár.
